```{r}
library(dplyr)

cases <- df %>%
  mutate(
    opened = as.POSIXct(requested_datetime,
                        format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OS"),
    closed = as.POSIXct(closed_date,
                        format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OS"),
    hours_to_close = as.numeric(
      difftime(closed, opened, units = "hours")
    )
  )

summary(cases$hours_to_close)
```


```{r}
# DATA CLEANING: Remove invalid closure times

# We found 9 cases with negative closure times (closed before opened).
# Remove these observations because closure time cannot be negative.
# Also remove cases with missing closure times.
# Keep the original dataset unchanged by creating a cleaned dataset.
# DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS: Outcome variable (Y)
# Calculate the mean, median, standard deviation,
# minimum, maximum, and quartiles of closure time.

summary(cases_clean$hours_to_close)

sd(cases_clean$hours_to_close, na.rm = TRUE)
cases_clean <- cases[
  !is.na(cases$hours_to_close) &
  cases$hours_to_close >= 0,
]

# Verify that no negative closure times remain
sum(cases_clean$hours_to_close < 0)

# Check the number of observations remaining after cleaning
nrow(cases_clean)


```

```{r}

# BOXPLOT: 311 Case Closure Times by Neighborhood
# Compare closure times across San Francisco neighborhoods.
# Hide outlier points and zoom in on the central 95% of closure times.
# Order neighborhoods by median closure time.

# Remove observations with missing neighborhood names
plot_data <- subset(cases_clean, !is.na(analysis_neighborhood))

# Calculate median closure time for each neighborhood
medians <- tapply(
  plot_data$hours_to_close,
  plot_data$analysis_neighborhood,
  median
)

# Order neighborhoods by median closure time
plot_data$analysis_neighborhood <- factor(
  plot_data$analysis_neighborhood,
  levels = names(sort(medians))
)

# Calculate the 95th percentile for a cleaner display
upper_limit <- quantile(
  plot_data$hours_to_close,
  0.95,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Increase left margin to fit neighborhood names
par(mar = c(5, 15, 4, 2))

# Create horizontal boxplot
boxplot(
  hours_to_close ~ analysis_neighborhood,
  data = plot_data,
  horizontal = TRUE,
  outline = FALSE,
  ylim = c(0, upper_limit),
  col = "lightblue",
  border = "steelblue",
  las = 1,
  cex.axis = 0.7,
  main = "311 Case Closure Times by Neighborhood",
  xlab = "Hours to Close",
  ylab = ""
)

```
